title: SC-ABE: reference implementation, experiments
description: Code, experiment scripts, tests and results for 'SC-ABE: Compact lattice-based attribute-based encryption for cohort access control in federated cyber-physical systems'. The identity-based encryption component is a functional/timing stand-in and is not adaptively secure.
